content: {"like":["Values high-quality computer graphics and CGI, especially in sci‑fi settings; appreciates strong, well‑executed acting and character design; enjoys stories with clear resolution and engaging plot twists; prefers films that balance humor and emotional depth; seeks faithful adaptations that honor source material."],"dislike":["Dislikes weak or confusing storylines, especially those that rely on excessive suspension of disbelief; rejects poor sound design and unclear dialogue; is averse to overly graphic violence and extreme content; dislikes films that lack clear explanations or rely on tacked‑on endings; avoids movies with unrealistic or exaggerated events that break immersion."]}
